params.message:
Show Stories in the site's white and grey, gallery in the column

The overview, the featured story and the stories row on a frame page drop
their beige ground and dark bar for white and the light grey of the photo
and text blocks. A story's gallery stays inside the reading column.

Portal: Het overzicht van Stories en de galerij in een artikel volgen nu de stijl van de rest van hoet.be.
